schema.description: Request schema for creating an opening.

end_time.description: The end time of the opening (24-hour clock, e.g. `17:00`). Must be after the start time. To open availability across midnight, create two adjacent openings.

start_time.description: The start time of the opening (24-hour clock, e.g. `09:00`).

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone the opening's times are authored in. Defaults to the provider's location time zone when omitted.

title.description: An optional display title for the opening.

schema.title: CreateOpeningRequest
